decision.title: good kid, m.A.A.d city (Deluxe)
tracklist: Sing About Me, I'm Dying of Thirst

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (15 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Good_Kid,_M.A.A.D_City, https://www.valueyourmusic.com/items/125153018814-3-bonus-tracks-kendrick-lamar-good-kid-m-a-a-d-city-deluxe-2lp-set-1116. Deluxe edition: standard 12 tracks + 3 bonus tracks (The Recipe feat. Dr. Dre, Black Boy Fly, Now or Never feat. Mary J. Blige). This is the standard deluxe configuration; iTunes/Target/Spotify variants add further retailer-exclusive bonus tracks.
